target_category: Governed AI-native field-service ERP for maintenance, installation, and repair firms with 10 to 100 technicians.
claim_boundary: This is a target scorecard. The repository may not claim a 9/10 product, production readiness, human UAT approval, legal compliance, or full multi-industry ERP coverage until matching evidence exists.
target_user: Field-service operations manager responsible for work quality, technician execution, customer handoff, and invoice readiness.
business_outcome: Turn a service request into assigned work, verified execution, margin-aware closeout, and one draft invoice without losing source evidence or crossing ERP authorization boundaries.
measurable_success_signal: A design partner rates the evidence-to-cash workflow at 9/10 or better and automated gates prove no duplicate stock issue, duplicate invoice draft, duplicate AI proposal, autonomous posting, or unauthorized finance visibility.

verified: Technician and manager responsibilities are separated in the local demo.
Draft invoices are finance-triggered, idempotent, and draft-only.
AI closeout proposals are cited, immutable, review-only, and non-posting.
Evidence replay and export packet are available on Service Work Order Desk as a single client path.
Replay harness fixtures cover closeout, repair memory, scheduling explanation, and exception recovery, plus finance and invoice handoff evidence packets.
Synthetic repair-memory history corpus and retrieval abstention edges are covered without live OpenAI.
Bounded scheduling uses van-warehouse readiness, skill/territory/SLA matching, and feedback rollups without auto-assign.
Demo Version loop and stack docs label the synthetic product without production claims.

Online technician mobile Desk path at 390 by 844 covers list, time, parts, inspection, attachment, closeout, cannot-close, validation copy, and forbidden-field denial; IndexedDB offline drafts stay gated off.
assumed: Small and midsize field-service teams value evidence replay more than generic chatbot breadth.
A 10 to 100 technician segment can validate the workflow without custom accounting or MRP.
deferred: Production deployment, counsel-signed legal approval, support ownership, live provider evaluation, and exact capacity evidence. In-repo compliance templates are not those approvals.
Distribution and manufacturing promotion beyond configured_demo.
Offline IndexedDB technician drafts (intentionally gated off).

system_records.entity: Customer, Item, Warehouse, Sales Invoice, Stock Entry, Project, and User
Service Request, Service Work Order, closeout, exception, execution fields, and industry workflow
AI Proposal, source citations, review metadata, and provider audit metadata

features.title: Verifiable evidence-to-cash ledger
features.input: Service request, work order assignment, technician time, parts, closeout notes, evidence, stock issue link, AI proposal, and invoice draft link.
features.output: A replayable chain from request to invoice-ready handoff and exactly one draft Sales Invoice.
features.decision_logic: Manager may mark invoice-ready only after closeout, exception, parts, tenant, and permission checks pass; finance may draft only through standard ERPNext Sales Invoice create permission.
features.validation_gate: Automated tests prove idempotent stock issue, idempotent draft invoice, role separation, and audit links.
features.feedback_loop: Failed closeout or missing evidence routes back to technician or manager with an owned exception.
features.failure_handling: Retries return existing linked records; partial or duplicate state blocks release.
features.optimization_step: Packet and timeline carry policy_category, citation hashes, and token/duration when returned; concurrent context-hash reuse is tested beyond packet rows. Partner packet review remains open before ≥9.0.
features.scalability_note: Permission-scoped lists and reports must pass the full private capacity profile before pilot activation.

features.title: Cannot-close recovery coach
features.input: Work order status, closeout fields, exception reason, downstream owner, due date, and escalation age.
features.output: Owned exception, manager notification, and optional draft recovery proposal.
features.decision_logic: The system escalates overdue Cannot Close records to a manager but never auto-closes work.
features.validation_gate: Scheduled-job, permission, replay-bundle, and browser tests prove overdue escalation, owned-exception confirm before draft creation, and draft-only recovery that cannot close work.
features.feedback_loop: Manager assigns the next human action or sends the work order back to technician execution.
features.failure_handling: Notification failure leaves the exception open and visible in manager queues.
features.optimization_step: Desk Draft Recovery Steps now confirms owner, due date, and reason before creating a cited draft. Partner UX review remains open for ≥9.0.
features.scalability_note: Exception queues must remain filterable by owner, due date, customer, and technician at capacity.

features.title: Margin leakage guardian
features.input: Bill rates, issued part costs, time rows, invoice readiness, discounts, repeat visits, and work-order exceptions.
features.output: Permission-scoped profitability view and margin risk explanations before finance handoff.
features.decision_logic: Finance-only profitability fields remain hidden from technicians; alerts explain risk without changing billing records.
features.validation_gate: Negative permission tests prove technicians cannot view or mutate finance fields; evidence chain exposes categories and source evidence to managers only; browser coverage proves the Desk summary button is manager/finance-only with status and date filters.
features.feedback_loop: Manager can send a job back for clarification or approve a finance handoff with known risk.
features.failure_handling: Missing cost data creates a visible exception instead of inventing margin; summary responses and the Desk dialog flag scan truncation and high-risk queue caps; the profitability report warns when the page bound truncates; truncation is true only when more than the page limit exists.
features.optimization_step: Add partner-reviewed leakage analytics after UAT; keep classification deterministic (no AI).
features.scalability_note: Profitability reports must use indexed filters and avoid unrestricted cross-tenant search.

features.title: Provenance-based repair memory
features.input: Role-visible historical work orders, source citations, closeout outcomes, parts, assets, and failure patterns.
features.output: Cited suggestions or abstentions for likely fix, missing evidence, and next diagnostic step.
features.decision_logic: Retrieval is permission-scoped (asset or location, never customer alone) and the AI must abstain when source evidence is weak or invisible to the role. Template renderers keep only citation-backed actionable history, drop weak subject-only rows, and redact contact or credential-shaped free text before writing draft_content.
features.validation_gate: Contract, provider, safety, retrieval-edge, synthetic corpus, and browser citation-match tests prove redaction, schema adherence, citation requirements, refusal, weak-evidence abstention, and no hidden-source leakage without live OpenAI.
features.feedback_loop: Approver rejection creates evaluation examples and updates retrieval quality notes.
features.failure_handling: Provider, cache, timeout, malformed output, or unsafe content failures return a safe unavailable/refusal category.
features.optimization_step: Live OpenAI aggregate eval once credentials exist; partner UX review still required for ≥9.0.
features.scalability_note: Retrieval must be bounded by tenant, role, source type, time range, and result count.

features.title: Safe agent replay
features.input: Typed ERP context, workflow state, allowed tool registry, policy result, proposal, and reviewer decision.
features.output: Replayable draft proposal with policy explanation and no autonomous ERP write.
features.decision_logic: Agents can plan and propose only inside registered workflow contracts; deterministic ERP code performs validation and authorized writes.
features.validation_gate: Replay tests prove no financial, stock, payroll, permission, compliance, or customer-message side effects across four proposal fixtures plus finance and invoice handoff packets. Bundles must cite every history entry, keep citation hashes, and use @today relative dates. Approve review events stay draft_only with allowed_action none.
features.feedback_loop: Rejected proposals feed evaluation cases and workflow policy updates.
features.failure_handling: Policy mismatch, missing citation, or model mismatch fails closed and records safe metadata only.
features.optimization_step: Beat J walks the AI safety table live for a ≥9 partner Safety rating; private live-provider aggregates remain blocked on credentials.
features.scalability_note: Replay storage must keep metadata and hashes, not raw prompts or provider responses.

features.title: Bounded scheduling optimizer
features.input: Technician availability, skills, territory, van warehouse, service location, SLA, work priority, duration, and parts readiness.
features.output: Ranked assignment suggestions with reasons and dispatcher approval controls.
features.decision_logic: Optimizer proposes assignments; dispatcher approves, edits, or rejects. No autonomous reassignment occurs.
features.validation_gate: Service and browser tests prove role checks, conflict handling, deterministic tie-breakers, skill/territory/SLA matching, van-stock readiness when the issue_parts warehouse is short, Explain Schedule drafts, rejection feedback rollup without auto-rescoring, and summed duplicate-part readiness aligned with issue_parts.
features.feedback_loop: Dispatcher rejection captures reason categories for future ranking review without changing scores automatically.
features.failure_handling: Missing availability, location, skill, or parts data produces an exclusion reason instead of a hidden assignment.
features.optimization_step: Van warehouse profiles and live feedback rollup landed in Desk. Partner-reviewed candidate UX remains open for ≥9.0.
features.scalability_note: Scheduling search must stay bounded by date window, territory, role, and candidate count.

features.title: Mobile field execution
features.input: Assigned work order, execution state, time, requested parts, notes, attachments, and permitted closeout fields.
features.output: Fast technician completion flow with no customer, finance, scheduling, assignment, share, or email privilege leakage.
features.decision_logic: Technicians may update execution fields only for assigned work orders; managers retain customer, billing, and assignment fields.
features.validation_gate: Desktop and mobile browser tests prove the 390 by 844 technician path: assigned list, time, parts, inspection, closeout attachment, cannot-close, 44px targets, accessible names, readable validation copy, forbidden-field matrix denial, and IndexedDB offline helpers still unloaded.
features.feedback_loop: Validation errors return the technician to the exact missing execution field.
features.failure_handling: Attachment or validation failure leaves the work order open with no partial invoice or stock side effect.
features.optimization_step: Add offline-safe draft capture only after field UAT proves the online mobile flow; IndexedDB remains gated off and not wired through app_include_js.
features.scalability_note: Technician lists must filter by assigned work and avoid loading finance or unrelated customer data.

features.title: Governed demo-to-pilot release
features.input: Static gates, Docker gates, browser evidence, release report, deployment manifests, capacity, restore, UAT, legal, and support records.
features.output: Truthful release state: demo ready, automated complete, deployment evidence complete, or pilot approved.
features.decision_logic: External pilot gates remain false until reviewed evidence exists; demo readiness does not imply production readiness. Compliance templates are inventory and counsel worksheets, not legal approval.
features.validation_gate: Quality gates and pilot readiness checks separate synthetic automation from human approvals and deployment evidence.
features.feedback_loop: Failed gates update backlog, roadmap, and traceability before another release attempt.
features.failure_handling: Missing AWS, OpenAI, legal, support, UAT, or design-partner evidence blocks pilot approval but not local demo release.
features.optimization_step: Demo Version packaging now includes config/demo-version.json plus loop and stack docs linked from README, AGENTS, and the facilitator runbook. Counsel-signed DPA/DPIA, support owner, UAT, and accountable go/no-go remain external.
features.scalability_note: Release evidence must remain synthetic or approved redacted data and must not include local Bench state.
